status.en: 63 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 43% fewer than the week before, most of them in Islamabad, Kabul and Peshawar.
status.nb: 63 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 43 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Islamabad, Kabul og Peshawar.

summary.en: Pakistani security forces carried out raids that killed militants in hideouts, while police in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa stopped a major terror attack in Lakki Marwat, killing a suspected suicide bomber. Army chief Munir was briefed on operations in Balochistan as a shutdown strike halted activity across the province. A Pakistani minister travelled to India for a SCO meeting, the first ministerial visit since the 2025 war. Separate bus collisions with gas tankers killed ten civilians each. The conflict produced 1,794 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Pakistanske sikkerhetsstyrker gjennomførte raid som drepte militante i skjulesteder, mens politiet i Khyber Pakhtunkhwa stoppet et stort terrorangrep i Lakki Marwat og drepte en mistenkt selvmordsbomber. Hærenes sjef Munir ble informert om operasjoner i Balochistan da en streik med nedstengning stoppet aktivitet i hele provinsen. En pakistansk minister reiste til India for et SCO-møte, det første ministerbesøket siden krigen i 2025. Separate busskollisjoner med gassoljetankere drepte ti sivile hver. Konflikten førte til 1 794 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
background.extract: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.
